description: Ingest Gong call metadata and transcripts via Gong API v2 and return a pandas DataFrame.

outputs.description: DataFrame of call metadata with optional transcript column

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

from_date_time.label: From Date/Time
from_date_time.description: Start of the call window (ISO-8601, e.g. '2026-06-01T00:00:00Z'). Required unless a time-based partition_type is set.

to_date_time.label: To Date/Time
to_date_time.description: End of the call window (ISO-8601, e.g. '2026-07-01T00:00:00Z'). Required unless a time-based partition_type is set.

include_transcript.label: Include Transcript
include_transcript.description: If true, fetch transcripts via POST /v2/calls/transcript and merge into the DataFrame

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of calls to fetch across all pages

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:revops) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['gong', 'python'].

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime)

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one run (the date-window filter already handles a multi-partition range correctly). 'multi_run' launches one run per partition. Leave empty for Dagster's default (one run per partition, uncapped). Ignored when Partition Type is not set. 'single_run' requires a partition-range-aware IO manager (e.g. a DB-table IO manager with partition_expr set) -- a generic filesystem/default IO manager cannot persist a single_run output spanning multiple partitions and will raise a clear error at materialization time.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key of the GongResource this asset depends on for authentication

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

name: Gong Calls Ingestion
